title: Add Bundle category + Farm the Aura hero copy + animated Aura MC branding + show ₹ cart total in header

requirements.text: Add a new top-level store option named "Bundle" alongside the existing top-level options (Lifesteal, Token SMP, Aura SMP, BoxPVP) so users can browse and purchase a bundle.

quotes: add a 1 more option of bundle

acceptanceCriteria: Homepage shows a fifth primary navigation tile/card labeled "Bundle" alongside the existing four categories.
Clicking "Bundle" navigates to a category page like other categories (same route pattern).

requirements.text: Implement the Bundle catalog content exactly as specified: a single purchasable bundle item priced in INR (₹1750) with the listed included rewards and the note that it is valid in any 1 realm.

quotes: you will get 5🔑 top keys 3 months top rank 750🪙 coins 10M 💸money For rupees sign 1750 valid in any 1  realm

acceptanceCriteria: The catalog data includes a new category with id "bundle" and name "Bundle".
The Bundle category contains exactly one purchasable item priced at ₹1750.
The Bundle item display includes the included rewards list: "5🔑 Top Keys", "3 Months Top Rank", "750🪙 Coins", "10M 💸 Money" and a note: "Valid in any 1 realm" (English, same meaning).
The Bundle item can be added to cart and behaves like all other products (quantity increases if added multiple times, removable, included in totals).

requirements.text: Update the homepage hero section to prominently include the phrase "Farm the Aura" using a high-quality display font style that matches the site’s premium/professional aesthetic.

quotes: write farm the aura in good font on first page

acceptanceCriteria: Homepage hero shows "Farm the Aura" as a prominent headline/sub-headline in addition to the existing Aura MC Store title and the "Happy Gaming" / "Happy Shopping" lines.

requirements.text: Add subtle, professional animations for Aura MC branding across the site (e.g., logo/brand text animation in the header and/or hero), without reducing readability or performance.
acceptanceCriteria: Aura MC brand element(s) (logo and/or "Aura MC" text) have a subtle animation (e.g., float, shimmer, glow pulse) visible on the homepage and in the persistent header.
Animations do not interfere with navigation, form inputs, or reading product/cart/checkout details.

requirements.text: Enhance the header cart entry point to show INR context by displaying the current cart subtotal formatted in ₹ next to the cart button when the cart is not empty (while keeping the existing cart item count indicator).

quotes: on top add add to Cart where it is written rupees

acceptanceCriteria: When cart has items, the header shows a cart entry point that includes the subtotal formatted in INR (₹) next to the cart icon/button.
When cart is empty, the header cart entry point does not show a misleading ₹ amount (may show just the icon or ₹0 depending on existing design, but must be clear).
The existing cart item count badge continues to work.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional canisters/services).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any other paths listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
All user-facing text must be in English.
Do not serve images from the backend; frontend must use static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated for any imagery.
nonGoals: Adding new payment methods beyond UPI.
Adding third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
Introducing external databases or off-chain storage.
Changing existing Lifesteal/Token SMP/Aura SMP/BoxPVP catalog structure beyond what is required to add the new Bundle category.
